points.title: 早年求学
points.description: 布哈林出生于莫斯科一个教师家庭，从小接受良好教育。1901年进入莫斯科第一中学，接触马克思主义思想。1906年加入俄国社会民主工党，开始革命活动。在此期间，他展现出非凡的才华，成为党内年轻的理论家。莫斯科的求学经历为他后来的政治生涯奠定了理论基础，也使他结识了早期的布尔什维克成员。
points.descriptionEn: Bukharin was born in Moscow to a teacher's family and received excellent education. He entered Moscow First Gymnasium in 1901 and was exposed to Marxist ideas. In 1906, he joined the Russian Social Democratic Labour Party and began revolutionary activities. During this period, he demonstrated exceptional talent and became a young theorist within the party. His educational experience in Moscow laid the theoretical foundation for his later political career and allowed him to meet early Bolshevik members.

points.title: 流亡理论家
points.description: 1907年因革命活动被捕，随后流亡国外，主要在维也纳、巴黎和伦敦等地。在流亡期间，布哈林深入研究马克思主义理论，发展了'过渡时期经济理论'，成为党内重要的理论家。1917年二月革命后返回俄国。这段流亡经历使他接触到欧洲社会主义运动的各种思潮，形成了独特的理论观点，但也导致他与列宁在一些理论问题上存在分歧。
points.descriptionEn: Arrested in 1907 for revolutionary activities, Bukharin went into exile, mainly in Vienna, Paris, and London. During his exile, he deeply studied Marxist theory and developed his 'transitional period economic theory,' becoming an important theorist within the party. He returned to Russia after the February Revolution in 1917. This exile experience exposed him to various currents of European socialist thought, forming his unique theoretical views, but also led to disagreements with Lenin on some theoretical issues.

points.title: 革命与内战
points.description: 十月革命后，布哈林成为《真理报》主编，积极参与革命后的政权建设。在内战期间，他支持'战时共产主义'政策，并参与起草了《布列斯特和约》。1921年后，他开始质疑'战时共产主义'政策，提出了'逐步过渡到社会主义'的理论，与托洛茨基的'不断革命论'形成对比。这一时期，布哈林成为党内的重要领导人，与斯大林、季诺维也夫等人组成'三人小组'，共同反对托洛茨基。
points.descriptionEn: After the October Revolution, Bukharin became editor of Pravda and actively participated in the construction of the post-revolutionary government. During the Civil War, he supported the 'War Communism' policy and participated in drafting the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk. After 1921, he began to question the 'War Communism' policy and proposed a theory of 'gradual transition to socialism,' contrasting with Trotsky's theory of 'permanent revolution.' During this period, Bukharin became an important party leader, forming a 'troika' with Stalin and Zinoviev to oppose Trotsky.

points.title: 新经济政策
points.description: 列宁去世后，布哈林成为党内最有影响力的理论家之一，支持并发展了新经济政策(NEP)。他提出了'和平长入社会主义'理论，主张通过市场机制逐步过渡到社会主义。1926年，布哈林与斯大林、李可夫等人组成'右翼联盟'，反对托洛茨基-季诺维也夫联合反对派。这一时期，布哈林的理论和实践对苏联的经济恢复和发展产生了重要影响，他的著作《过渡时期经济学》成为马克思主义理论的重要著作。
points.descriptionEn: After Lenin's death, Bukharin became one of the most influential theorists in the party, supporting and developing the New Economic Policy (NEP). He proposed the theory of 'peaceful growth into socialism,' advocating for a gradual transition to socialism through market mechanisms. In 1926, Bukharin formed a 'right-wing alliance' with Stalin and Rykov to oppose the Trotsky-Zinoviev united opposition. During this period, Bukharin's theories and practices had a significant impact on the economic recovery and development of the Soviet Union, and his book 'The Economics of the Transition Period' became an important work of Marxist theory.

points.title: 失势与批判
points.description: 1929年，斯大林转向'左倾'路线，开始批判布哈林的'右倾机会主义'。布哈林被解除《真理报》主编职务，并被开除出政治局。随后，布哈林被迫公开认错，放弃了自己的理论观点。尽管如此，他仍保留在中央委员会和共产国际执行委员会的职位。这一时期，布哈林虽然失去了政治影响力，但仍继续从事学术研究，撰写了《历史唯物主义理论》等重要著作。他的失势标志着苏联政策从新经济政策转向强制集体化和快速工业化。
points.descriptionEn: In 1929, Stalin shifted to a 'leftist' line and began to criticize Bukharin's 'right opportunism.' Bukharin was removed as editor of Pravda and expelled from the Politburo. Subsequently, Bukharin was forced to publicly recant and abandon his theoretical views. Nevertheless, he retained his positions in the Central Committee and the Executive Committee of the Comintern. During this period, although Bukharin lost his political influence, he continued to engage in academic research and wrote important works such as 'The Theory of Historical Materialism.' His fall marked the shift of Soviet policy from the NEP to forced collectivization and rapid industrialization.

points.title: 大清洗
points.description: 1934年基洛夫被暗杀后，大清洗运动开始。1937年，布哈林被开除出党，并以'人民公敌'的罪名被捕。在1938年的'莫斯科审判'中，布哈林被指控参与反革命阴谋，最终被判处死刑并立即执行。在审判过程中，布哈林曾试图为自己辩护，但最终屈服于压力。他的死标志着苏联党内最后一批老布尔什维克领导人的消失，也象征着斯大林个人独裁的完全确立。布哈林直到1988年才被平反，恢复名誉。
points.descriptionEn: After the assassination of Kirov in 1934, the Great Purge began. In 1937, Bukharin was expelled from the party and arrested on charges of being a 'people's enemy.' In the 'Moscow Trials' of 1938, Bukharin was accused of participating in a counter-revolutionary conspiracy and was sentenced to death, which was immediately carried out. During the trial, Bukharin attempted to defend himself but ultimately succumbed to pressure. His death marked the disappearance of the last of the old Bolshevik leaders in the Soviet party and symbolized the complete establishment of Stalin's personal dictatorship. Bukharin was not rehabilitated and his reputation restored until 1988.

appraisal.zh: 布哈林通常被看作苏联早期最杰出的马克思主义理论家之一，其「和平长入社会主义」的主张为新经济政策下的经济恢复提供了思路，《过渡时期经济学》《历史唯物主义理论》等著作对马克思主义理论有所贡献，他坚持党内民主、反对个人独裁，失势后仍保持理论思考。另一种看法认为，这一理论忽视了阶级斗争的尖锐性，难以应对复杂的国际环境，他早年支持战时共产主义曾加剧经济崩溃与农民起义，与斯大林的斗争中又显得软弱妥协、政治天真，未能及时认清斯大林主义的危险。他由此成为苏联史上最具悲剧色彩的人物之一，其思想转变也映照出早期政策的摇摆。
appraisal.en: Bukharin is generally regarded as one of the most outstanding Marxist theorists of the early Soviet period: his idea of peaceful growth into socialism offered a path for economic recovery under the NEP, works such as The Economics of the Transition Period and The Theory of Historical Materialism contributed to Marxist theory, and he upheld inner-party democracy against personal dictatorship, continuing to think theoretically after his fall. Another view holds that this theory overlooked the sharpness of class struggle and could not meet a complex international environment, that his early backing of War Communism worsened economic collapse and peasant uprisings, and that he proved weak, conciliatory and politically naive in the struggle with Stalin, failing to recognize Stalinism's danger in time. He thus stands as one of Soviet history's most tragic figures, his shifts mirroring the vacillations of early policy.

supporter.zh: 布哈林被视为苏联早期最杰出的马克思主义理论家之一。他的'和平长入社会主义'理论为苏联经济恢复提供了重要思路，新经济政策下的实践取得了显著成效。布哈林坚持党内民主原则，反对个人独裁，体现了真正的布尔什维克精神。他的著作《过渡时期经济学》和《历史唯物主义理论》对马克思主义理论发展做出了重要贡献。即使在失势后，他仍保持理论思考，展现了知识分子的独立人格和勇气。
supporter.en: Bukharin is regarded as one of the most outstanding Marxist theorists in early Soviet history. His theory of 'peaceful growth into socialism' provided important ideas for Soviet economic recovery, and his practice under the NEP achieved significant results. Bukharin upheld the principles of inner-party democracy and opposed personal dictatorship, embodying the true spirit of Bolshevism. His works 'The Economics of the Transition Period' and 'The Theory of Historical Materialism' made important contributions to the development of Marxist theory. Even after his fall from power, he continued theoretical thinking, demonstrating the independent personality and courage of an intellectual.

critic.zh: 批评者认为布哈林的理论存在严重局限，他的'和平长入社会主义'忽视了阶级斗争的尖锐性，无法应对苏联面临的复杂国际环境。在内战期间，他支持'战时共产主义'政策，导致经济崩溃和农民起义。在与斯大林的权力斗争中，布哈林表现出政治上的软弱和妥协，最终未能有效抵抗斯大林的独裁统治。他的悲剧命运部分源于自身的政治天真和缺乏足够的政治手腕，未能及时认识到斯大林主义的危险本质。
critic.en: Critics argue that Bukharin's theories had serious limitations. His 'peaceful growth into socialism' overlooked the sharpness of class struggle and could not address the complex international environment facing the Soviet Union. During the Civil War, he supported the 'War Communism' policy, which led to economic collapse and peasant uprisings. In his power struggle with Stalin, Bukharin showed political weakness and compromise, ultimately failing to effectively resist Stalin's dictatorship. His tragic fate was partly due to his own political naivety and lack of sufficient political skill, failing to recognize the dangerous nature of Stalinism in time.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，布哈林被视为苏联历史上最具悲剧色彩的人物之一，代表了党内温和派与激进派之间的张力。他的思想经历了从'战时共产主义'支持者到新经济政策倡导者的转变，反映了苏联早期政策的摇摆。在流行文化中，布哈林的形象常被塑造成'失去的良知'，代表了斯大林时代被牺牲的理想主义。他的生平成为研究苏联政治演变和知识分子命运的典型案例，展示了个人在极权体制下的脆弱性与复杂性。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Bukharin is regarded as one of the most tragic figures in Soviet history, representing the tension between moderate and radical factions within the party. His thought evolved from a supporter of 'War Communism' to an advocate of the NEP, reflecting the vacillations of early Soviet policy. In popular culture, Bukharin is often portrayed as the 'lost conscience' of the revolution, representing the idealism sacrificed during the Stalin era. His life has become a typical case for studying the evolution of Soviet politics and the fate of intellectuals, demonstrating the vulnerability and complexity of individuals under totalitarian systems.

self.zh: 革命不是请客吃饭，不是做文章，不是绘画绣花，不能那样雅致，那样从容不迫，文质彬彬，那样温良恭俭让。
self.en: Revolution is not a dinner party, or an essay, or a painting, or a piece of embroidery; it cannot be so refined, so leisurely and gentle, so temperate, kind, courteous, restrained and magnanimous.
